svg.title: Seize and Hold
svg.desc: Seize and Hold measured battlefield. North is up. Arrows measure terrain edges and objective centers from table edges. Terrain labels give width by depth in inches. Score held sites at the end of rounds 2–6.

g.text: Arrows: distance to edge or point. All measurements in inches.
Score held sites at the end of rounds 2–6.
Follow the drawn terrain edges. Tree symbols do not add obstacles.
